title: Nikita Tuli
text:
Experience & Projects
Shirley Ryan Ability Lab Hospital
AI Implementation Intern

Designed and implemented AI-driven tools to automate administrative and operational workflows in a clinical setting, improving efficiency and allowing staff to focus more on patient care.
Created applications that saved an estimated amount $50,000 a year.
Partnered with clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders to identify workflow bottlenecks, define system requirements, and support deployment of data-informed solutions.

Solvay Chemical
Digital Transformations Intern

Developed custom digital tools and Power Apps that replaced manual workflows and improved operational efficiency across the Green River facility.
Built and trained CNNs using machinery sensor and operational data to support predictive maintenance and reduce unplanned downtime.

COVID-19 Genome Sequenencing and Alignment Project

Analyzed DNA sequence data using bioinformatics techniques to reconstruct and align genomic sequences against the SARS-CoV-2 reference genome.
Performed sequence alignment and comparative analysis to identify similarities, differences, and potential mutations relative to the COVID-19 genome. -Applied computational methods and data analysis tools to evaluate genomic variation and interpret biological significance.

Empower VR Project

Led a cross-functional team of 10–12 students to develop a VR-based women’s self-defense training application.
Designed immersive learning features and coordinated closely with design and engineering teams to ensure cohesive functionality.
